title: The Hollow Ember Revisited
author: Ansel Oyelaran
blurb: Edmund Vasquez, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
